id: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy (2004)
title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
tagline: San Diego news at six. Cheese board at seven.
about: A San Diego news anchor's world is turned upside down when a talented woman joins the newsroom.
cue: Serve the cheese when Ron finds out what Baxter did to the cheese.
faces: The News Team. Number one in San Diego.
Supper, drinks and the whole Channel 4 family. The rundown is inside.
FROM THE DESK OF RON BURGUNDY
Tonight we eat like kings and drink like gentlemen. Number one in San Diego, people.
Lime steak, jack, avocado, sour cream
Little franks in pastry, yellow mustard
Crisp chicken, corn tortillas, lime cream
Blackberry and lemon soda, no liquor
Hot, black and bottomless, from the urn
Fresh brewed, lemon wedge, sugar bowl
Prices subject to change. All plates go on the station tab. Mr. Fantana’s cologne is not permitted near the buffet. KVWN Form 4-75. San Diego, California, 1975.

KVWN-TV Channel 4AnchormanEat well, San Diego.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersBaxter's wheel of cheeseBaked brie, honey, thyme, walnuts, crackers.Baxter ate a whole one. Good boy.How to make it500g brie wheel2 tbsp honey1 small bunch thyme, leaves picked50g walnuts, roughly chopped1 packet crackersScore the top of the brie, drizzle with honey and scatter over the thyme and walnuts.Bake at 180°C on a lined tray until molten. Serve with crackers. Baxter would approve.Carne asada friesLime steak, jack cheese, avocado, sour cream.Hometown pride, San Diego style.How to make it500g skirt steak2 limes, juiced2 garlic cloves, crushed1 tsp ground cumin750g frozen fries150g Monterey Jack, grated1 avocado, mashed100g sour creamMix the steak with the lime juice, garlic and cumin.Marinate for 1 hour (included in cook time).Grill the steak hot, 3 minutes a side, then rest and chop.Bake the fries on a tray at 220°C until crisp.Cover with Monterey Jack and grill to melt.Top with the steak, avocado and sour cream.MainsSan Diego chicken tacosCrisp chicken, corn tortillas, cabbage, salsa, lime cream.Block B, the lead story. Runs six minutes.How to make it600g chicken breast, cut into strips60g plain flour1 tsp smoked paprika1/2 tsp ground cumin2 eggs, beaten100g panko breadcrumbs2 tbsp olive oil150g sour cream2 limes12 corn tortillas200g cabbage, shredded2 tomatoes, diced1/2 onion, dicedCut the chicken into strips and coat in the flour mixed with paprika and cumin, then egg, then panko.Arrange on a lined tray, drizzle with oil and bake at 220°C, turning halfway, until golden and the thickest piece reaches 75°C.Mix the sour cream with the juice of one lime for the crema, and toss the tomato and onion with the juice of the other lime.Warm the tortillas as the packet says and fill with chicken, cabbage, salsa and crema. Keep any chilli on the side.SweetsRon's butterscotch pudSelf-saucing brown sugar sponge, vanilla ice cream.Scotch, neat. Ron's.How to make it60g butter150g self-raising flour175g dark brown sugar1 pinch salt125ml full cream milk1 egg1 tsp vanilla extract1 tbsp cornflour2 tbsp golden syrup250ml boiling water500ml vanilla ice creamHeat the oven to 180°C conventional and grease a deep 1.5L baking dish with a little of the butter.Whisk the flour with part of the sugar and the salt, then whisk melted butter, milk, egg and vanilla in another bowl and fold together just until combined.Spread into the dish. Mix the rest of the sugar with the cornflour and sprinkle over the batter.Dissolve the golden syrup in the boiling water and pour gently over the back of a spoon without stirring.Bake on a tray until the sponge is set and a skewer in the sponge comes out clean. The sauce stays underneath.Rest, then scoop into bowls with the warm butterscotch sauce and vanilla ice cream. All the butterscotch flavour, no whisky.DrinksWell, I never!Blackberry and lemon soda, no liquor.The whole news team raises a glass.How to make it125g blackberries40g caster sugar60ml water2 lemons, juiced to give 60ml, plus slices to serve800ml chilled sparkling water1 bag iceSimmer the blackberries, sugar and water for 5 minutes, crushing the berries.Strain and cool completely.Divide the syrup and lemon juice between ice-filled glasses, top with sparkling water, stir and taste for sugar. Serve with lemon slices. No alcohol.
